ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels on the visible lobe surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white patch situated in the upper-right quadrant of the visible lobe, bounded by low-intensity black margins on the left, right, and bottom. Small, high-contrast white focal points are distributed in the lower-left black region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the trailing edge; characterized by at least seven distinct jagged peaks and deep-cut valleys creating a non-linear, sawtooth boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature observed on the outer (right) leading edge, terminating in a sharp, upward-pointing distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of circular, high-contrast white pixel structures (barnacles) concentrated at the distal tip and along the upper leading margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, nearly vertical parallel white linear marks in the center-left black field; additional fine-scale horizontal scratches intersecting the white-to-black pigmentation transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular jaggedness on the trailing edge indicative of significant tissue loss or historical trauma; a single circular white lesion/scar is visible at the base of the fluke near the water line.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized heavy bio-fouling (barnacle colonization) specifically restricted to the distal tip and extreme outer margin.
